run_visualize_detections: run the script to visualize detection results from a detections.pkl file with configurable threshold
run_vis_with_limit: run the vis function to visualize only the first k images from a detections pickle file
run_vis_with_custom_thresh: run the vis function with a custom probability threshold to filter low-confidence detections
run_parse_args_help: run parse_args to print help text and exit when no command line arguments are provided
run_vis_with_output_dir: run the vis function to save visualization output images to a custom output directory
